title.zh: 最大为 N 的数字组合
title.en: Numbers At Most N Given Digit Set

desc.zh: 通过首个不同数位，把逐个检查变成互不重叠的计数块。
desc.en: Count disjoint blocks by the first digit that differs from the bound.

complexity: O(Lm) time; O(L) auxiliary space, where L = len(str(n)) and m = len(digits)

concepts.name: First differing digit
concepts.description: Partition same-length numbers at their first smaller digit.

concepts.name: Equal-prefix invariant
concepts.description: Only the prefix equal to the bound needs further comparisons.
